title: Data Commons agent configuration
description: Schema for this deployment's agent-config.json, which deploy.sh uploads to the config bucket and the agent reads once at startup. One deployment, one file.

api_keys.description: Key pool for rotation. Leave it empty: the real values belong in Secret Manager, named by GEMINI_API_KEYS_SECRET. The agent prefers that and falls back to this array, so a key left here is a key on disk.

demo_api_keys.description: Separate pool for demo / public-facing traffic. Same Secret-Manager-in-prod policy applies via GEMINI_DEMO_API_KEYS_SECRET.

api_key.description: DEPRECATED single-key fallback. Still honoured, with a warning. Use api_keys[], or better, Secret Manager.

api_base.description: Override for regional / vNext Gemini endpoints.

mcp_model.description: Model used for the MCP tool-loop / planner.

kb_model.description: Model used for the File Search / KB phase.

filestores.description: Gemini File Search corpus IDs (one or more; sharded RAG when multiple).

server_url.description: Where the agent talks MCP. In the sidecar deployment shape this is the in-task localhost endpoint; the network-MCP form is supported for split-service deployments.

enabled.description: Set false to run synthesis-only (no tool loop). Used for chat-only fallback when MCP is down.

_comment.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.

enabled.description: Toggle the File Search RAG phase. False disables the KB pipeline entirely for instances without a corpus.

store_id.description: DEPRECATED single-corpus shim. Use gemini.filestores[] instead. Schema accepts it for backward shape compat; agent ignores it.

_comment.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.

mcp_level.description: Reasoning budget for the tool-loop / planner. Primary cost/latency dial.

synthesis_level.description: Reasoning budget for the final synthesizer. Primary cost/latency dial.

prompts.description: System prompts. The bodies live in prompts/*.md and are merged in at startup; this object can override individual slots inline if you would rather keep a prompt in the config file. The agent renders {{instance.*}} placeholders against template_vars before sending to Gemini.

template_vars.description: Variables substituted into prompts when they are sent to Gemini. Keys are case-sensitive; reference them in prompts/*.md as {{instance.<key>}}. A placeholder with no matching key is left in the prompt verbatim rather than blanked. Keys beginning with _ are never substituted.

name.description: Display name of the instance (e.g. 'India', 'Karnataka', 'New Jersey').

region.description: Default geographic context for ambiguous queries.

states_term.description: Local term for sub-national administrative units ('states', 'districts', 'counties', 'provinces').

query_param_key.description: Soft-gate token for demo links, supplied as ?key=<this>. Gates model/thinking overrides and ?demo=true, which switches to the reserved demo API keys. OMIT THIS KEY unless you need demo links: with none configured, those overrides are refused outright. Never commit a real value, and never reuse one across instances.

proxy_url.description: Legacy: where the agent binds. PROXY_PORT in the container environment is the source of truth; this key is accepted only for backward compatibility.

$schema.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.

$comment.description: Free-text annotation for maintainers. Ignored by the agent.
